blocks.text: Following the momentum of ShopeeVIP+, Shopee has announced its newest addition to the “Shopping meets Streaming with One subscription, more ways to stream!” offering: YouTube Premium Lite. Starting 11 November, ShopeeVIP+ subscribers in Indonesia, Thailand and the Philippines will have access to both YouTube Premium Lite and Netflix, with no additional fee beyond the ShopeeVIP+ subscription fee. With YouTube Premium Lite, ShopeeVIP+ subscribers can: Existing ShopeeVIP+ members can activate YouTube Premium Lite in the Shopee app or through the activation link sent via e-mail or SMS from 11 November at no additional cost.
